"""
new = """            if rnd.random() < 0.55:
                # follow a class signature so segments can match
                cls = rnd.randrange(rel['classes'])
                seen = len([o for o in ops if o[0] == 'packet' and o[1] == fid])
                cand = [r for r in rel['train'] if r['class'] == cls and r['values']]

                    vals = [v for v in cand[0]['values'] if v != PAD]

                        v = vals[seen % len(vals)]

cd /workspace/dev && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site timeout 900 python3 - <<'EOF' 2>&1 | tail -20
import sys, json, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import gen, difftest
stats=collections.Counter(); bad=0
for i in range(200):
    rnd=random.Random(5000+i)
    req=gen.make_request(rnd)
    ok,got,want,ge,we=difftest.run_one(req)
    if not ok:
        bad+=1
        print('MISMATCH seed',5000+i,ge,we)
        json.dump(req,open('/tmp/f_%d.json'%(5000+i),'w'))
        json.dump(got,open('/tmp/f_%d.got'%(5000+i),'w'))
        json.dump(want,open('/tmp/f_%d.want'%(5000+i),'w'))
        if bad>2: break
        continue
    if 'error' in got: stats['error']+=1; continue
    for c in got['catalog']:
        stats['frag']+=len(c['fragments']); stats['noise']+=len(c['noise'])
        stats['clusters']+=len(c['clusters']); stats['kept']+=sum(1 for x in c['clusters'] if x['kept'])
        stats['entries']+=c['entries']; stats['nodes']+=len(c['backup'])
    for d in got['decisions']: stats['reason_'+d['reason']]+=1
    for ins in got['installs']: stats['install_'+ins['status']]+=1
print('mismatches',bad); print(dict(stats))
EOF
